question: The women of which tribe perform the traditional folk dance called Chakri?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanjar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chakri Dance

 
 
• Chakri dance is one of the famous folk dances that are performed by the women of Rajasthan. 
 
• Chakri is the dance of the tribe **called Kanjars.**__
 
• Popular in area of Kota and Baran district of Rajasthan.
 
• The unique factor of the Chakri dance is that this is purely performed by the women of Rajasthan.
